sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant Orders
  participant Inventory
  participant Payments
  Note over Client: Order placement
  Client->>Orders: placeOrder(cart)
  activate Orders
  Orders->>Inventory: reserve(items)
  alt inStock
    Orders->>Payments: charge(total)
    Payments-->>Orders: receipt
  else
    Orders-->>Client: backorder
  end
  Orders->>Orders: notify()
  deactivate Orders
sequence.plantuml:
@startuml
participant Client
participant Orders
participant Inventory
participant Payments
note over Client: Order placement
Client -> Orders: placeOrder(cart)
activate Orders
Orders -> Inventory: reserve(items)
alt inStock
  Orders -> Payments: charge(total)
  Payments --> Orders: receipt
else
  Orders --> Client: backorder
end
Orders -> Orders: notify()
deactivate Orders
@enduml
